messages.startNodeRequired: Pipeline must have at least one Start node
messages.endNodeRequired: Pipeline must have at least one End node
messages.invalidCronExpression: {label} has an invalid cron expression. Must be 6-field NiFi syntax.
messages.orphanNode: {label} is not connected to any other node
messages.minimumFunctionalNodes: Pipeline must have at least one functional node between Start and End
messages.duplicateTableName: Two Geo Persistence tables must not have the same name
messages.cronMqttIncompatible: A CRON trigger cannot be used with an MQTT data source. Use a SQL (pull) source instead.
messages.cronSourceConnectorUnknown: Could not verify the source connector; a CRON trigger only works with a SQL (pull) source, not MQTT.
messages.sqlSourceNoScheduleDefaultPoll: This SQL source has no CRON node and will poll on the default schedule (every 5 minutes). Add a CRON node to set an explicit schedule.
messages.sqlSourceToFrost: A SQL source can only write to a FROST sink through a field mapping — add a mapping node or use a SensorThings (MQTT) source.
messages.frostMappingUnknownStaTarget: {label} maps {path} — not a valid SensorThings target path; allowed are the catalog paths of the Thing-shaped target model (e.g. $.name, $.Datastreams[].name, $.Datastreams[].Observations[].result) plus its match keys
messages.frostMappingMissingMatchKeys: {label} must map the {entity} match keys: {fields} — they identify the entity during find-or-create
messages.frostMappingNoMatchKeyInStructure: {label}: the target structure declares no match key for {entity} — mark an attribute with the UML '{id}' flag or add a "reference" attribute
messages.frostMappingCreateSetIncomplete: {label} maps {entity} partially; creating it also requires: {fields} (or map none of the create fields for lookup-only)
messages.frostMappingLocationNeedsCreatableThing: {label} maps a Location — that requires a fully mapped Thing (name, description), since Locations are created via its deep insert
messages.frostMappingFeatureOfInterestNeedsObserv: {label} maps a FeatureOfInterest without an Observation — the feature is deep-inserted into the observation body
messages.frostMappingUnsafeMatchKeyName: {label}: the match-key name "{keyName}" is not a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; must not start with a digit) — rename the attribute
messages.frostMappingReservedMatchKeyName: {label}: the match-key name "{keyName}" is reserved — it must not be named after the properties bag it lives in; rename the identifying attribute
messages.frostMappingFallbackMatchKey: {label}: no '{id}' attribute marked — the match key falls back to "reference"
messages.nodeNotWired: {label} must be connected with both an incoming and an outgoing edge
messages.mappingRequiredFieldsMissing: {label} does not map all required target fields: {fields}
messages.mappingNotSaved: {label} has no saved field mapping — open the mapping editor and save it
messages.mappingDataCorrupt: {label} carries no valid mapping data — delete the node and recreate it
messages.edgeEndpointMissing: An edge references a node that does not exist — remove the edge
messages.sourceNodeRequired: Pipeline has no data source node; exactly one wired data source is required
messages.sinkNodeRequired: Pipeline has no data sink node (sensor or geospatial data storage); exactly one wired data sink is required
messages.multipleSourceNodes: {label} is an additional data source node; a pipeline supports exactly one
messages.multipleSinkNodes: {label} is an additional data sink node; a pipeline supports exactly one
messages.nodeUnsupportedPosition: {label} is wired in an unsupported position
messages.unknownNodeInFlow: {label} has an unsupported node type and cannot be wired into the data flow
messages.flowBranches: The data flow branches at {label}; a linear source-to-sink flow is required
messages.flowCycle: The data flow contains a cycle at {label}
messages.noDataPath: There is no data path from the data source to the data sink
messages.mappingNotOnPath: {label} is not on the data path between the data source and the data sink
messages.cronTriggerCapacity: {label} is an additional schedule trigger on the data source; its trigger port holds at most one
messages.mappingChainStructureMismatch: The output data structure in mapping node {upstreamLabel} and the input data structure in mapping node {label} are incompatible
